07/26.11.2020:
Both these petitions have been filed challenging the orders passed by the adjudicating authority.
The said orders were appealable before the Tribunal in terms of Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
As the Tribunal was not constituted, the petitioners have approached this Court challenging the impugned orders.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the order dated 12.10.2019 passed by this Court in WP(Cr.) No. 57/2014, the State has notified and constituted the Tribunal in terms of Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.
Since the Tribunal has already been constituted, this Court feels that it would be appropriate for the petitioners to challenge the orders impugned before the Tribunal.
Thus, I direct the petitioners to approach the Tribunal by way of filing appropriate appeal(s).
This Court is not entering into the merits of these cases.
If the appeal(s) is filed, the same should be considered on merits.
Accordingly, both these petitions are disposed of.
